name: contrail
description: AI harness for Salesforce work: org connections with human-set grants, metadata search & diffs, dependency graphs, SOQL, and human-approved deploys.
long_description: Contrail lets Claude work inside your Salesforce orgs the way an architect would — searching metadata, tracing dependencies, diffing orgs, querying records — while every write (deploys and DML) requires a human-read confirmation code shown only on a local approval page. Access is scoped per-connection by five explicit grants (metadata read/write, data read/write, diagnostics), enforced server-side. Refresh tokens live in the OS keychain; everything runs locally.
